grantRoles(address,uint256).details: Allows the owner to grant `user` `roles`. If the `user` already has a role, then it will be an no-op for the role.

renounceRoles(uint256).details: Allow the caller to remove their own roles. If the caller does not have a role, then it will be an no-op for the role.

revokeRoles(address,uint256).details: Allows the owner to remove `user` `roles`. If the `user` does not have a role, then it will be an no-op for the role.

transferOwnership(address).details: Allows the owner to complete the ownership transfer to `pendingOwner`. Reverts if there is no existing ownership transfer requested by `pendingOwner`.

params.confirmOwner: The address of the new owner of the contract.

owner().notice: Get the address of the owner

transferOwnership(address).notice: Set the address of the new owner of the contract This is the final step in the 3-step-with-timeouts transfer approach
